review_scope: production promotion design; no production writes

gates.finding: All 226 candidates have a verified publication date but no verified time. The dry RSS serializes date-only values as 00:00 UTC.
gates.recommended_resolution: Approve 00:00 UTC strictly as an RSS serialization convention and retain date_precision=date_only; do not represent it as an exact NPR publication time.

gates.finding: 78 of 226 enclosure lengths are known; the remainder serialize as 0.
gates.recommended_resolution: Optionally perform validated HEAD/range probes before promotion. Existing feed code already permits a zero length when NPR does not expose one.

gates.finding: Only the isolated builder exists; there is intentionally no production writer.
gates.recommended_resolution: Implement an explicit, hash-guarded promotion command that writes all three files together, validates them, and aborts before replacement on any failure.

gates.finding: A production promotion must be a dedicated Git commit with no unrelated files.
gates.recommended_resolution: Require a clean targeted diff and retain the pre-promotion hashes in the report.

workflow_compatibility.scheduled_feed_updater: Compatible: existing GUIDs are retained and only unseen current-feed GUIDs are appended.
workflow_compatibility.bulk_enclosure_recovery: Compatible: promoted map entries are resolved and therefore not re-queued.
workflow_compatibility.complete_feed_builder: Compatible, but production promotion should reuse the reviewed atomic writer rather than manually editing generated XML.
